title: Provenance Integration Audit - per-item verdicts
overall_verdict: PASS (10 items PASS, 1 item PASS WITH LIMITATIONS, 0 FAIL)
scientific_question: Does explicitly accounting for provenance/dependence between pieces of evidence change conflict resolution decisions compared with treating the evidence as provenance-neutral?
answer: YES - on PHEME+RumourEval real data, provenance-aware aggregation changes the decision in 24/80 (30%): 6 genuine flips (9.7% of 62 both-resolved) and 18 resolution-to-abstention changes (22.5%); margins compressed in 76/80. MSM V1 remains the primary evaluation of the overall mechanism.

items.title: Separate empirical evaluation of the provenance contribution
items.evidence: Self-contained provenance/evaluation tree; all tool writes confined to evaluation/_data; sibling to qacc/results/processed_results/msm/pheme_test.

items.title: No contamination of QACC TEST / MSM V1 ablations / frozen params / validated results
items.evidence: Frozen + primary-output paths have mtimes predating the provenance build; tools reference no such write paths; frozen protocol/SIGNAL hashes verified.

items.title: Aware and neutral arms share identical cases/observations/candidates/gold
items.evidence: Same 80 case-ids/multiset; identical gold/n_units/n_origins/category; both arms reproduced from the shared manifest units - only the aware flag differs.

items.title: 24/80 interpretation: 6 flips + 18 resolution->abstention, not 24 reversals
items.evidence: Exact decomposition verified; every flip is correct<->wrong; report 07 never uses 'reversal'.

items.title: Aware strict drop is a policy consequence, not an error
items.evidence: strict = selective*coverage exactly; drop = 42->34 fully explained by 8 right-abstentions; flips net to zero; selective aware >= neutral.

items.title: 76/80 margin compression from same candidate sets
items.evidence: Recomputed 76/1/3; aware per-origin support never exceeds neutral in all 80; delta = |support diff| verified in both arms.

items.title: P1/P5 target-vs-built consistent everywhere
items.evidence: election_targets vs elected_counts identical in 02/08 and equal to built cases (P1=14, P5=6); documented as coverage limitation in 01/07/09/README.

items.title: Claims grounded in observed/reconstructed structure; no author/text inference
items.evidence: classify/_gold_pair use only root/depth/branch/ancestor; user_id confined to trust timeline; artifact 04 explicitly excludes authorship/text; 03 audit 100% in_reply_to agreement.

items.title: Reproducibility chain: input/tool/output hashes + deterministic rerun
items.evidence: All recorded hashes re-verified (60/60); two runs byte-identical modulo build_timestamp; order-deterministic construction. Limitation: index.pkl byte-rebuild from archive not re-executed (pinned by hash instead).

No parameters optimized using PHEME TEST outcomes
No new cases created during the audit
